from math import *
def appro2():
    nb=1
    x0=1
    x1=1-sin(x0)
    d=abs(x0-x1)
    while d >= (10**-4):
        x0=x1
        x1=1-sin(x0)
        d=abs(x0-x1)
        nb=nb+1
    print("La valeur approché est: ",x1)
    print("Le nombre d'iteration est: ",nb)
appro2()
